title: Syrian Grilled Melon Kebabs
description: A refreshing and sweet summer dish featuring grilled melon and a hint of Syrian spices.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, and paprika.
Add the melon cubes to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread the melon cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the melon is slightly charred.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh mint leaves if desired.
